consequence.statement: A configuration using the Docker provider with swarmMode is unsupported in v3 and prevents Traefik from starting.
consequence.remediation: Do not use swarmMode with the Docker provider; use the Swarm provider instead.

original.statement: In v3 the Docker provider's swarmMode option is unsupported (Swarm moved to a separate Swarm provider), and configuring providers.docker.swarmMode prevents Traefik from starting.

decision.reason: [ev-c6ee7d3b73da] shows the v2 configuration providers.docker.swarmMode=true (file or CLI) and says "This configuration is now unsupported and would prevent Traefik to start." Its remediation is to stop using swarmMode on the Docker provider and use the Swarm provider instead. Traefik refusing to start after the upgrade is a failed upgrade, so upgrade-blocked with high severity fits, and the proposed statement and remediation match the evidence.
